Description:
  Run generative AI models locally, privately, and offline.
  
  Command groups:
    Model:  model, cache
    Run:    run, chat, complete, transcribe
    Server: server
    Setup:  config
    Help:   status, report

Usage:
  foundry [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --version              Show version information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  model                      Discover, inspect, download, load, and unload local models
  chat <model>               Start an interactive local chat session
  complete <model> <prompt>  Generate one stateless text completion
  run <model>                Run a model with automatic routing to chat or transcription
  server                     Start, stop, restart, inspect, and troubleshoot the local Foundry daemon
  cache                      Inspect and manage downloaded model cache entries
  config                     View and edit persistent Foundry CLI settings
  status                     Show system, service, model, and connectivity diagnostics
  report                     Open a pre-filled GitHub issue with diagnostics
  transcribe                 Start an interactive local speech transcription session or transcribe a file

Description:
  Start, stop, restart, inspect, and troubleshoot the local Foundry daemon

Usage:
  foundry server [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  start    Start the Foundry daemon and OpenAI-compatible local service
  stop     Stop the Foundry daemon
  restart  Restart the Foundry daemon and OpenAI-compatible local service
  status   Show daemon state, URLs, PID, uptime, and log location
  logs     Show or follow daemon and SDK log lines

Description:
  Discover, inspect, download, load, and unload local models

Usage:
  foundry model [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Commands:
  list, ls          List catalog models with optional filters
  info <model>      Show model details, variants, size, and hardware targets
  download <model>  Download a model or variant into the local cache
  load <model>      Load a downloaded model into the local daemon
  unload <model>    Unload a model from memory in the running daemon

Description:
  Load a downloaded model into the local daemon

Usage:
  foundry model load [<model>] [options]

Arguments:
  <model>  Model alias, variant id, or model id. If omitted, an interactive picker launches.

Options:
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]

Description:
  Download a model or variant into the local cache

Usage:
  foundry model download [<model>] [options]

Arguments:
  <model>  Model alias, variant id, or model id. If omitted, an interactive picker launches.

Options:
  -f, --force            Re-download even if the model is already in the local cache.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  -o, --output <format>  Output format (text|json). Defaults to text. [default: Text]
